# APPENDIX B  
## HEALTH PLANS  
### TERMS OF COVERAGE – YEAR 2003  

| Fire Fighters Anthem Health Insurance Comparison Chart | | | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Effective January 1, 2003 | | | |
| * PCP refers to Primary Care Physician. | ** Major Medical | | |
| BENEFIT | ANTHEM BLUE PRIORITY (HMO) | ANTHEM BLUE ACCESS (PPO) | |
| | Management | Network | Non-Network |
| Eligible Salary Divisions | Fire Fighters | Fire Fighters | Fire Fighters |
| Paycheck Deduction | Yes<br>Single - $10<br>Family - $20<br>Deductions are per month. | Yes<br>Single - $10<br>Family - $20<br>Deductions are per month. | Not applicable |
| Maximum Annual Out of Pocket | Single - $500 out of pocket expenses.<br>Family - $1,000 out of pocket expenses<br>The amounts include all copays except Rx. | Single - $300 out of pocket expenses<br>Family - $600 out of pocket expenses<br>These amounts includes all copays except Rx. | Single - $100 deductible then 30% for everything until you reach $600 then covered 100%= Total $700.<br>Family - $300 deductible (2 persons) then 30% paid to $1,200 then100% is covered=Total $1,400. |
| Network Sizes | This plan uses the same network doctors and facilities as Anthem100 Union. | 1,200 PCP and1,100 Specialists | Not applicable. |
| Dependents (over age 19) | Unmarried children to end of the year age 24, if main residence is with subscriber & are eligible as Federal tax exemptions. | Unmarried children to end of the year age 24, if main residence is with subscriber & are eligible as Federal tax exemptions. | Unmarried children to end of the year age 24, if main residence is with subscriber & are eligible as Federal tax exemptions. |
| Lifetime Maximum amount per individual. | No maximum | $2 million combined.<br>Network and non-network. | $2 million combined.<br>Network and non-network. |
| Disease Management Program | Covered. | Covered. | Not covered. |
